sections.content: Why We Begin With the Sign of the Cross

The Sign of the Cross is the simplest yet deepest prayer in Catholic tradition. It is not merely a prelude to prayer—it is a prayer in itself that marks your body as consecrated to God and recalls your baptism.

sections.title: Trinitarian Foundation
sections.content: By invoking the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, you declare your faith in one God in three Divine Persons.

items: **Touch your forehead:** 'In the name of the Father...'
**Touch your left shoulder:** '...and of the Holy...'

sections.content: Use your right hand with open fingers together or with your thumb and first two fingers joined, representing the Trinity and the dual nature of Christ.
